note: The product-only tool stack partitioned into one MCP server per mirrored system. Every name is defined by a cited contract under mcp/v3/contracts; no synthesized Gen-1 tools are routed here.

practice-management.product: LexOperis PM (SIMULATED) — mirrors Clio Manage API v4
practice-management.description: Matters, contacts, time and expense, billing, trust, calendars, tasks, notes, communications, users, practice areas, and audit activity.

docket-records.product: CourtDock Records (SIMULATED) — mirrors CourtListener REST API v4
docket-records.description: Courts, dockets, docket entries, RECAP documents, opinions, citation resolution, parties, and docket alerts.

courtfile-efiling.product: CourtFile ECF (SIMULATED) — mirrors documented CM/ECF NextGen workflow semantics
courtfile-efiling.description: Case selection, PDF filing, docket entries, and Notices of Electronic Filing. Documentation-fixture fidelity; no public common write API is claimed.

deadline-rules.description: Trigger- and service-aware federal civil deadline calculation with rule citations.

dms.product: MatterVault DMS (SIMULATED) — mirrors iManage Work API
dms.description: Workspaces, folders, documents, versions, checkout/checkin, download, and full-text search.

ediscovery.description: Review workspaces, document query/search/coding, productions, privilege logs, legal holds, and asynchronous jobs.

workspace.product: Fieldstone Workspace (SIMULATED) — mirrors Google Workspace APIs
workspace.description: Sheets, Drive, Gmail, and Calendar operations used by the benchmark workflows.

ebilling.description: UTBMS code lookup and standards-conformant LEDES 1998B serialization and submission.

esign.product: SealPoint eSign (SIMULATED) — mirrors Docusign eSignature REST API v2.1
esign.description: Envelope creation, sending, status polling, and ordered recipients.
